assertions.name: unfinished mission and finite task start countdown without keyword
existing injection in flight suppresses countdown
context token overflow guard suppresses continuation
three unchanged successful continuation cycles stop at stagnation threshold
actual child completion resets stagnation and permits continued mission
cooldown expiration permits countdown on a later idle event
failure count resets after five-minute window on a later idle event

limitations: Real installed decision and progress-store functions; SDK responses, clock, countdown and environment guards are stubbed.
Does not start timers, inject provider prompts, exercise live background tasks, or verify service restart/session restoration.
Todo status snapshots are progress proxies; Github evidence remains acceptance authority.
Cooldown expiry does not create an independent scheduler event.
